# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Brent settles at $96.57 as Iran reports mine strikes and Ras Tanura loadings reportedly halt](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 27, 2026. What happens to US crude when the Gulf's export doors start closing? Brent settled up 2% at $96.57 on Thanksgiving after Iran's Guards said two tankers hit mines near Hormuz and CNN reported Saudi loadings stopped at Ras Tanura.
- [Midstream: Targa is in talks to buy Blackstone backed Kinetik, Bloomberg reports](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Upstream: OPEC+ goes into Sunday expected to hold output steady into 2027](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Gas and LNG: Petronas and Staatsolie take FID on Suriname's first offshore gas project](https://uticamidstream.com/#suriname)
- [Midstream: First Nations get C$168 million loan guarantee for a Coastal GasLink stake](https://uticamidstream.com/#cgl)
- [Cross-industry: Iran's mine claims pile up as it ties reopening Hormuz to US demands](https://uticamidstream.com/#hormuz)
